changelog: fix: the sample-by-sample beta heatmaps (17_beta_heatmap_bray/jaccard) came and went between renders; STAMP figures never drew. (1) Root cause, from r_render.log: by section 17 a stray device was open (ggplot opens R's default device on its own when building a figure). pheatmap measures text on a throw-away pdf(NULL) and when it closes it R makes the next device current - the stray one - so the heatmap was drawn there, our PNG never received a page and no file was written, while the log still said Saved. open_dev() now closes every open device before opening the figure's own. Reproduced (bray lost with the old code, both drawn now). (2) The clean-up added in 2.9.26 read the figure's path after dev.off() had cleared it, giving "invalid 'file' argument" - the jaccard heatmap's error in 2.9.27. (3) STAMP (19_stamp_*) failed at every rank with 'names do not match previous names': it rbind()-ed one data.frame per taxon after Bioconductor packages had replaced rbind. It now builds the table column by column, and sums names split across lineages first (duplicated names would also have broken factor()). (4) ANCOMBC2 volcano subtitle reads 'Reactor vs feed' instead of 'Grouping4Reactor'.

previous.changelog: fix: 2.9.26's clean-up deleted a good figure (12_upgma_jaccard). The check for a figure left half-drawn compared device numbers only. After the jaccard tree was saved and closed, ggplot opened R's default device on its own to build the next figure, it took the same number, and the check took it for the unfinished jaccard tree and deleted the PNG. dev.off() now forgets the figure it closes, so only a figure that really failed is removed. Reproduced (file deleted with 2.9.26, kept now). Also: the ANCOMBC2 volcano says which contrast it is and how many taxa were tested and significant, and its key reads 'not significant' / 'q < 0.05' instead of FALSE/TRUE. Checked against the 2.9.26 render: UPGMA trees coloured by group, 17_beta_heatmap_bray present, species counts without 'Unclassified' (Species 32 vs Genus 89 for Pre-R1), volcano drawn.
